function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values, and `sample_seq` shows that 48 patients were re-tested (i.e., have multiple rows). This means the dataset contains multiple rows per patient, which violates the one-per-patient assumption needed for the population definition.", "implication": "The population is defined as 'all patients' — not all rows. function.name: note_finding
